parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is the top cover of the pot, made of ceramic, circular in shape, and fits snugly on the container.
parts.Functional_description: It serves to cover the pot, preserving heat and preventing contents from spilling or evaporating.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or rotated slightly to open or close the pot.

parts.name: Container
parts.Basic_description: The container is the main body of the pot, made of ceramic, with a bulbous shape for holding liquids or solids.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the main contents of the pot, such as water, soup, or other materials.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use but can be lifted or tilted when pouring.

parts.name: Bottom
parts.Basic_description: The bottom is the base of the pot, made of ceramic, providing stability and support.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the pot and ensures it stands upright on flat surfaces.
parts.Movement_description: It does not move independently; it remains fixed as the base of the pot.
